item.title: Peace on Earth: Taking God’s Blessings with Joy [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Joy to the world—or at least, joy in the midst of it! Whether it’s the weight of trials or the responsibilities that come with His gifts, we talk about taking it all with gratitude and faith. With Christmas as our backdrop, we dig into how true peace on Earth comes from trusting God’s plan, embracing His blessings, and finding joy in the journey He sets before us. And we remind ourselves why Christmas is the season of hope, even when the world feels heavy. Tune in for the laughs, the encouragement, and the call to live boldly, no matter the season!

item.title: Enraging Culture: MLK 50 Fallout (Flashback Friday) [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Originally aired on April 15, 2018. This week we were joined by two pastors, Craig Houston and Joe Carlson. Craig is Pastor of Westside Baptist Church in Bremerton, WA, and a contributor to 95 Thesis for a New Reformation. Joe is pastor of Trinity Bible Church in Felton, CA, and is the author of several poetry books, which you can find over at Jovial Press.

item.title: Biden Pardons & Presidential Justice w/ Attorney Davis Younts [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: What is the deal with all the presidential (or potential presidential) pardons happening? Should Biden have pardoned his son? And what implications does this have on the next four years?? Today the CrossPolitic Guys are joined by Attorney Davis Younts to discuss all the presidential pardons, the legal implications, and the justice of it all.

item.title: United States vs. Skrmetti | Advent & Beer & Psalms [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: In this episode of CrossPolitic, the team covers two hot topics: Tennessee Attorney General Andrew Skrmetti's legal battles, including his stance on key cultural issues, and a fun discussion on Beer & Psalms, where they talk about the intersection of Christian faith, celebration, and enjoying a good drink.

item.title: Should Canada Become the 51st State w/ Jacob Reaume [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: In this episode of CrossPolitic, guest Jacob Reaume joins the discussion on the provocative question: Should Canada become the 51st state? Together, they explore the potential benefits and challenges of Canada merging with the U.S., examining political, economic, and cultural implications. Tune in for a lively conversation on the future of Canada and its relationship with its southern neighbor.

item.title: Dr. Jay & Dr. Cole - Bold & Honest Science in the Face of Mishandled Government (ThrowBack Show) [CrossPolitic Show]
item.description: Dr. Jay and Dr. Cole join CrossPolitic to expose the bold truth about the government’s mishandling of science during COVID. From fear tactics to outright lies, we dig into how bureaucratic overreach distorted public health policies, silenced dissenting voices, and manipulated the narrative. A must-listen episode for anyone seeking clarity in a world of deception!
